0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons, 2-0 and first in the Central, visit the Philadelphia 76ers, who are also 2-0 and first in the Atlantic. Detroit is without Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain) and Ausar Thompson (day-to-day, ankle sprain, game-time decision), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), LeBron James (out, back), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won their 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
